description: This is a shell script that manages the setup and execution of an OpenClaw container via Podman, including environment setup, token generation, configuration management, and container lifecycle commands.

methods.name: resolve_user_home
methods.description: Resolves the home directory of a given user.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Prints an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: validate_single_line_value
methods.description: Validates that a given value does not contain control characters.

methods.name: validate_absolute_path
methods.description: Validates that a path is absolute and does not contain dot segments or repeated slashes.

methods.name: validate_mount_source_path
methods.description: Validates that the mount source path is absolute and does not contain colon characters.

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_regular_file
methods.description: Ensures a file exists, is a regular file, and is not a symlink.

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_dir
methods.description: Ensures a directory exists, is not a symlink.

methods.name: stat_uid
methods.description: Gets the UID of a file or directory.

methods.name: stat_mode
methods.description: Gets the permission mode of a file or directory.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_dir_owned_by_user
methods.description: Ensures the directory exists, is owned by the current user, and is not group/world writable.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_regular_file_owned_by_user
methods.description: Ensures the file exists, is owned by the current user, and has owner-only permissions.

methods.name: ensure_safe_write_file_path
methods.description: Ensures the file path is safe for writing.

methods.name: write_file_atomically
methods.description: Writes data to a file atomically with specified permissions.

methods.name: load_podman_env_file
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a specified file, removing comments and handling key-value pairs.

methods.name: validate_port
methods.description: Validates that a port number is numeric and within valid range.

methods.name: resolve_config_gateway_bind
methods.description: Resolves the gateway bind mode from openclaw config.

methods.name: upsert_env_var
methods.description: Sets or updates an environment variable in a file.

methods.name: generate_token_hex_32
methods.description: Generates a 32-byte hex token using available commands.

methods.name: create_token_env_file
methods.description: Creates a token environment file with restricted permissions.

methods.name: sync_local_control_ui_origins_via_cli
methods.description: Synchronizes the allowedOrigins in gateway control UI via CLI using Python for JSON processing.

methods.name: sync_local_control_ui_origins
methods.description: Synchronizes the allowedOrigins in the gateway control UI configuration file.

methods.name: cleanup_token_env_file
methods.description: Removes the temporary token environment file on script exit.
